title: 5 孙翔任务，完成了
slug: 全职高手首先你不会被一见钟情
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

耳边传来咳嗽声。

周珈蓝松开键盘，弯腰捂住嘴，雪白长发纷纷披垂，肩膀瘦薄仿佛下一秒就要折断。

孙翔如梦方醒，不理会七期群里已经爆炸的艾特消息，“虽然你输了，但我承认你很厉害。”

网吧键盘不顺手，新号装备不熟悉，身体不舒服没手感……问题很多，但周珈蓝一句话都没说。

战绩是一回事，她这种态度又是另一回事，孙翔心里不承认，但其实已经开始暗暗佩服……心脏变得很热，迫不及待。

他兴致勃勃道，“我要去嘉世了你知道吧，一叶之秋，斗神，以后就是我的账号卡了。越云有你在肯定差不了，往后赛场再见，你拿上阿茜娜，我拿一叶之秋，咱们再痛痛快快打一场！”

周珈蓝没说话，低头一直咳嗽一直咳嗽，孙翔耐心等了一会儿，越等越着急，直接上手去扳她的肩膀，“喂周珈蓝你没事吧……”

声音越来越轻越来越接近气音，孙翔瞪大眼睛，惊恐地看着周珈蓝指缝里渗出血。

“你咳血？”孙翔茫然。

下一秒，“卧槽，被我打吐血了？赶紧起来啊我送你上医院！！”

系统面板在闪烁。

【任务：对孙翔叫哥哥，并得到回应。】

【失败惩罚：肺疾加重（50％致死率）】

两行字正闪烁刺眼的红光，像某种冰冷的警告。

“不是吐血，是任务失败……”周珈蓝细声细气道。

孙翔站着，满脸茫然，“任务？游戏任务？”

周珈蓝没再继续解释，下一刻，半透明的系统面板突兀出现在孙翔面前。

刺眼的红光持续闪烁，整个包间被映照得明灭不定，危险冰冷的红色渲染整个世界，雪白色长卷发像是在淌血。

“卧槽，卧槽，任务，我……吗？”孙翔只花了两秒钟接受这个魔幻的设定。

“那你赶紧叫啊？”

周珈蓝看着孙翔的眼睛。

孙翔眼睛其实偏圆，眉弓高挺所以看起来凶，但漫天红光里他的表情意外地没那么不耐烦了，反而像个大毛绒狗狗，清澈见底，有点惊恐，还有点愚蠢。

是会变成人类好帮手的那种模样。

“……”孙翔又说不出话了。

捂嘴的手拿开之后，周珈蓝简直是在呕血，大团大团的血渍从嘴巴里鼻子里涌出来，她咳嗽得像是要喘不过气。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

There was a coughing sound in my ears.

Zhou Jialan let go of the keyboard, bent down and covered his mouth. His long snow-white hair was hanging down, and his shoulders were so thin that they seemed about to break in the next second.

Sun Xiang woke up from a dream and ignored the news about Aite that had exploded in the seventh group group. "Although you lost, I admit that you are very powerful."

The Internet cafe keyboard is not smooth, the new account equipment is not familiar, the body feels uncomfortable and the hand feels... There are many problems, but Zhou Jialan didn't say a word.

The record is one thing, but her attitude is another. Sun Xiang didn't admit it in his heart, but he actually began to admire her secretly... His heart became very hot and he couldn't wait.

He said enthusiastically, "I'm going to Excellent Era, you know, One Autumn Leaf, God of War, will be my account card from now on. Yueyun will definitely be good with you here, see you in the field later, you take Athena, I will take One Autumn Leaf, let's have a good fight!"

Zhou Jialan didn't say anything. He lowered his head and kept coughing. Sun Xiang waited patiently for a while. The more he waited, the more anxious he became. He directly reached for her shoulder and said, "Hey Zhou Jialan, are you okay..."

The voice became softer and softer, closer to the sound of breath. Sun Xiang's eyes widened and he watched in horror as blood seeped out from Zhou Jialan's fingers.

"Are you coughing up blood?" Sun Xiang was confused.

The next second, "Damn it, did you vomit blood after being hit by me? Get up quickly and I will take you to the hospital!!"

The system panel is flashing.

[Task: Call Sun Xiang brother and get a response.】

[Failure penalty: worsening of lung disease (50% fatality rate)]

The two lines of words were flashing with a dazzling red light, like some kind of cold warning.

"It's not vomiting blood, it's a mission failure..." Zhou Jialan said softly.

Sun Xiang stood with a confused look on his face, "Mission? Game mission?"

Zhou Jialan did not continue to explain. The next moment, the translucent system panel suddenly appeared in front of Sun Xiang.

The dazzling red light continued to flash, and the entire private room was illuminated. The whole world was rendered in dangerous and cold red, and the long, snow-white curly hair seemed to be bleeding.

"Holy shit, shit, mission, am I...?" It only took Sun Xiang two seconds to accept this magical setting.

"Then why don't you call me quickly?"

Zhou Jialan looked into Sun Xiang's eyes.

Sun Xiang's eyes are actually round, and his eyebrows are high, so he looks fierce, but in the red light of the sky, his expression is surprisingly less impatient, and instead looks like a big stuffed dog, crystal clear, a little scared, and a little stupid.

It's the kind of person who will become a good helper to mankind.

"..." Sun Xiang was speechless again.

After the hand covering her mouth was removed, Zhou Jialan was literally vomiting blood. Big balls of blood poured out of her mouth and nose. She coughed as if she couldn't breathe.
